curation.notes: Dual-trap optical tweezers (LUMICKS C-Trap with a 3-phase laminar-flow microfluidic chip) unfolding/refolding of Ox40 3'UTR RNA stem-loops (CDE, ADE, tandem ADE-CDE, full-length 1-140) tethered between streptavidin and anti-digoxigenin silica beads through lambda-DNA handles, with real-time binding kinetics of the murine Roquin-1 ROQ domain (coreROQ and extROQ) extracted from passive-mode traces by HMM. NMR, CD, EMSA and hydroxyl-radical probing complement the SMFS; no AFM was used despite the auto record's secondary technique.

evidence.snippet: All measurements were performed using a trap stiffness between 0.25 pN/nm and 0.40 pN/nm, and at temperatures of ~ 25 °C.
Data were downsampled from the initial sampling rate of 78.125 kHz by a factor of 3 before analysis.

handle_sequences.annotations: Biotin and digoxigenin-functionalized handles were PCR-amplified separately using a lambda-phage template DNA, forward primers with biotin or digoxigenin modifications, and backward primers introducing ssDNA overhangs
